Yes, Poland ships fine. The T. P2 is $379, 10 TH/s, 166 W — about 120 kWh a month, so roughly $20 at 17¢. Note 21% import VAT is charged on delivery, not at checkout.

What do you pay per kWh?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

The B.4 is $599.99, 18 TH/s, ~300 W at the wall — about 216 kWh a month, roughly $37 at 17¢. Water-cooled, ~50 dB, Mean Well PSU included. Ships to Poland, same 21% import VAT on arrival.

Nearly double the Thor P2's hashrate for 1.6x the price — better value per TH. What's your actual rate per kWh?

0.80 zł is about 20 US cents, so the BS-4 runs you roughly 173 zł a month in power, the Thor P2 about 96 zł.

At that rate I'd take the BS-4: three times the hashrate of the P2 for under twice the running cost, so each sat costs you less, and triple the shot at a block every ten minutes.

Want me to put one in the cart?
